maddeler.e: الْبَحْرُ الْمَيِّتُ or اَلْبَحْرُ الْمَيْتُ • (al-baḥru l-mayyitu or al-baḥru l-maytu) m
maddeler.t: Calque of Ancient Greek Νεκρά Θάλασσα (Nekrá Thálassa), from Latin Mare Mortuum, from the paucity of the lake's fish due to its extreme salinity.
s: Calque of Ancient Greek Νεκρά Θάλασσα (Nekrá Thálassa)
g: Dead Sea (a highly saline lake in Israel, Palestine and Jordan)
